note: Adapted from Emerson’s 1952 original English description; measurements taken from 3 soldiers in the author’s collection, with values from Holmgren’s 1906 original account added, in millimetres. The original did not describe the alate or the worker.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Closest to C. villosus, differing in the wider angle of the right mandibular notch (75—90°) and the smaller size; soldier head length including mandibles about 4.06 mm, versus 4.63—4.69 mm in C. villosus.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head, pronotum and abdomen pale yellow (one paratype soldier darker, possibly due to preservation). Upper surface of the head with many long setae, both upper and lower surfaces covered with a dense, contrasting short hair blanket; postmentum covered with short hairs, with only a few setae at the front; pronotum with many setae and some short hairs on the anterior margin and the rest of the surface; tergites and sternites both with setae and hairs, the hairs of the sternites slightly longer. Sides of the head slightly curved and nearly parallel. Frontal tube rather short, depressed in lateral view, its tip not higher than the back of the head; the underside of the base of the frontal tube lodged in a depression of the head surface. Postmentum proportionally narrow relative to the head, at its narrowest about half the greatest width or slightly more (paratype 0.32:0.64 mm; specimen collected by the author 0.39:0.64 mm). Antennae 15-segmented, segments 2, 3 and 4 about equal in length. Lateral corners of the labrum rounded, bluntly pointed, the margin between the base of the white median lobe and the lateral corners straight. Angle of the right mandibular notch 75—90°. Anterior margin of the pronotum distinctly concave. Measurements (mm; original Table 29, n=1—4, means in parentheses, including the values recorded by Holmgren 1906): head length including mandibles (estimated) 4.06; head length to the tip of the frontal tube 2.79—2.88 (2.83); head length to the lateral mandibular bases 2.94—2.95 (2.94); head width 2.00—2.20 (2.12); head thickness 1.46—1.47 (1.46); frontal tube length 0.29—0.31 (0.30); labrum width 0.71—0.76 (0.73); left mandible length 1.39—1.47 (1.43); right mandible length from the notch 0.71—0.76 (0.73); pronotum length 0.50—0.61 (0.57); pronotum width 1.10—1.18 (1.14); hind tibia length 1.67.
